preset.description: Preset to sync. `ai-flow presets` lists them; mixins cannot be used directly.

extends.description: Mixin(s) layered after the preset. `ai-flow presets` lists the mixins; a mixin cannot be the preset itself.

vars.description: Overrides for template vars, deep-merged over the preset. `ai-flow vars` prints the resolved set.

collab.description: Commits, PRs, issues, review comments, test labels.

toolRules.description: Markdown bullets added to the shared rules of every role and to CLAUDE.md.

extraTools.description: Tools added to every Claude Code subagent wrapper, for example MCP tools.

commands.description: Commands rendered into workflow `run:` steps and role briefs. Must match the package manager the workflows install with (`check` warns on a mismatch). Defaults come from the preset's vars.json (node-base unless the preset overrides).

install.description: Dependency install step in the CI workflows. Default `npm ci`; use `npm install` when the lockfile was regenerated on a different npm version or platform and `npm ci` fails.

installNoScripts.description: Install step of the managed commitlint workflow (scripts skipped for speed and safety). Default `npm ci --ignore-scripts`.

lintFix.description: Auto-fix lint issues locally. Default `npm run lint:fix`.

format.description: Format the files. Default `npm run format`.

lint.description: Lint check run by the reviewer and quality gate. Default `npm run lint -- --diagnostic-level=error`.

test.description: Full test suite, run by the CI test workflow. Default `npm test` (node-ts: `npx vitest run --reporter=dot`; react-native-firebase adds `-- --silent`).

testFiles.description: Test suite scoped to paths; the literal placeholder `<paths>` is replaced per run. Default `npm test -- <paths>`.

testChanged.description: Test suite over the changes since the PR base (node-ts, typescript-vite-firebase). Default `npx vitest run --changed HEAD^1 --passWithNoTests --reporter=dot`.

build.description: Build check run by the build-check workflow. Default `npx tsc --noEmit` (node-ts: `npm run build`).

deadCode.description: Dead-code check run by the build-check workflow. Default `npm run knip`.

extraChecks.description: Extra verification prose injected into the quality-gate role. Default `none.`; the firebase mixin adds a functions build check.

testRules.description: Firestore/storage rules test suite (firebase mixin). Default `npm run test:rules`.

version.description: Node version installed by the workflows' setup-node step. Default `22`.

unitPaths.description: Globs (as a YAML list in a string) that trigger the unit-test workflow. Defaults to the preset's source and config paths.

rulesPaths.description: Globs that trigger the firebase rules test workflow (firebase mixin).

includes.description: Globs linted by Biome, rendered into `biome.json`. Defaults to the preset's source paths.

entry.description: Entry files for Knip, rendered into `knip.json`. Defaults to the preset's entry points.

priorityList.description: Markdown file ranking screens for the UI audit. Default `docs/ux/screens-audit-priority.md`.

reportDir.description: Directory where UI-audit reports are written. Default `docs/ux`.

safeArea.description: Prose naming the app's safe-area wrapper, injected into the UI-auditor brief.

e2ePolicy.description: Prose policy for E2E tests, injected into the role briefs. Default `Never run E2E tests. The user runs them manually.`

skillPath.description: Path of the review skill the reviewer role loads. Default `.agents/skills/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review/SKILL.md`.

docsDir.description: Directory of EGM design documents. Default `docs/designs`.

extra.description: Project rules injected into the role briefs (Markdown bullets).

disabledRoles.description: Roles whose brief and wrapper are not synced (and are removed when synced before).

disabledFiles.description: Managed or seed paths that are not synced. Managed files synced before are removed.

disabledSkills.description: Skills from the preset to leave out.
